title: DetourLab experiment v1
description: Two to six closure variants over one unchanged network, fleet and ordered demand. This original MIT-licensed schema checks JSON structure; DetourLab runtime validation remains authoritative for references, record-ID uniqueness, UTF-8 size, UTF-16 string lengths, aggregate limits and safety checks.

format.title: Experiment format marker
format.description: Identifies an experiment document rather than a legacy scenario.

version.title: Experiment format version
version.description: The experiment format version is exactly 1.

name.title: Experiment name
name.description: Nonblank display label. The runtime limit is 120 UTF-16 code units.

baseScenario.title: Shared clear-road scenario
baseScenario.description: Complete scenario v1 with closures: []. Every variant uses exactly this geometry, fleet, dispatch times, ordered demand and deadlines. Place closure events in variants only.

closures.title: Empty base closure schedule
closures.description: Must be empty; closure schedules belong to variants.

variants.title: Closure variants
variants.description: 2–6 named schedules over the shared scenario. The runtime checks unique variant IDs, at most 8000 closure records and at most 48000 closure edge references across all variants.

id.title: Variant ID
id.description: Unique within this experiment's variants. The runtime checks uniqueness.

name.title: Variant name
name.description: Nonblank display label. The runtime limit is 120 UTF-16 code units.

closures.title: Variant closure schedule
closures.description: An empty array is a clear-road control. All edge IDs must reference the shared base scenario; the runtime checks those references and aggregate experiment limits.
